title: digitaria abyssinica var. scalarum

This plant has been traditionally used in medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Digitaria abyssinica var. scalarum include treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, thanks to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
